sentences: In online metric traveling salesperson problems, arriving points must be inserted into an evolving tour while preserving earlier ordering decisions.
An array formulation also limits how much unused space is available for future insertions.
The extracted question asks whether the classical logarithmic competitive ratio can be improved even when this space restriction is removed.
Thus the obstacle persists beyond tight array capacity and concerns the underlying irreversible tour construction.
A better guarantee would establish that online geometric ordering can approach the offline tour more closely than the long-standing insertion bound suggests.
